reference_observations.description: The head/chief and bishop/évêque analogies and geological comparison are substantive. Preserve the evidence of use in the species chapter by September 29, 1857 for the next period, without assigning a current-period knowledge date.

The incomplete 1857 Doubleday reply has seen specimens and responds to packing concerns and the January 26 communication. Its missing opening does not erase the identifiable surviving prior source; assess the whole chain in 1856–1857.

Edmondston’s 1856 incoming fragment concerns pigeon movement, uniform Rock Dove colour and drift trees. Distinguish belief and hearsay from measured migration and retain its missing opening and ending.
Keep Wedgwood’s seven-block moral-instinct critique, embedded Darwin quotations and later Darwin response notes separate; preserve the II 392 versus 292 reference conflict.
The carriage is explicitly awaited. The later account amount of £128 12s 6d is not a delivery witness.

corrections.description: The worker retains body-read and source-kind letter flags despite its corrected prose. The surviving text is council minute 1118, not the missing Darwin body; primary unavailable-body status governs.
Council minute 1141 reports a missing letter. The before-January-7 dating and January-13 council action are distinct; acceptance of a proposed translation does not prove that it was undertaken.
The twelve-page draft is in Henrietta’s mother Emma’s hand, not Charles’s mother’s hand. Emma’s copying does not make the absent draft her authored contribution.
Preserve the full 23-block errata list and separate Darwin annotation. His all-inserted note does not prove every correction entered the published text; the apparatus identifies exceptions.
The complete 91-block diploma includes Latin, translation and signatories. Its 1861 issue date and December 1862 transmission do not supply an 1861 Darwin receipt.

The missing secretary letter is represented by the November 4 minute. Darwin’s letter read at that meeting is identified as surviving 1364; it is not itself established missing. Preserve the Sowerby identity qualification.
Manuscript entrusted to Erasmus on Sunday and a hope Charles now has it do not prove Charles’s receipt. This is Hensleigh’s review of Charles’s manuscript, not a jointly authored Darwins manuscript.
Friday-note arrival on Saturday is Hensleigh’s receipt; misdirected family correspondence does not establish Charles’s knowledge at that time.

summary: Sixteen targets and four contexts reuse accepted full-source primary readings after source and evidence hash matching. The substantive linguistic, moral-instinct, experimental and editorial records are preserved, but no new 1851–1855 relationship is established. Three sources remain leads for 1856–1857. Missing letters represented by institutional minutes remain unavailable, and the diploma document date does not establish receipt.
